title: Sughra Ton Vichoray De Sadmey Nayi Jharay Janay
body:
Rab Jaanay Eday Veeran Haye Rab Jaanay Eday Veeran
Karbal Chon Kadon Aunay
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Din Ja Ali Akbar Pardes Vasaya Aye x2
Us Din Ton Hi Nanay Da Haye Us Din Ton Hi Nanay Da
Roza Vi Pareshaney
<<DIVIDER>>
Paigham Koyi Ghal Daeen Babul Main Namani Nu x2
Meray Veer Ne Shagana Dey Haye Meray Veer Ne Shagana Dey
Sehray Ney Kadon Laanay
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Jey Pata Honda Tenu Jaan Na Deyndi Mey x2
Pardes Ch Jakay Tu Haye Pardes Ch Jakay
Menu Khat Vi Nayi o Paanay
<<DIVIDER>>
Mey Jina Dey Sang Ralkay Asghar Nu Khadandi Sa x2
Meyto Veer Lukawan O Haye Meyto Veer Lukawan O
Ki Hoya Khuda Janay
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Lasha-e-Akbar Tey Shabbir Khara Akhay x2
Uth Parley Mera Bachra Haye Uth Parley Mera Bachra
Khat Behjeya Sughra Na
<<DIVIDER>>
Teray Sogh Ch Pitdey Ney Zanjeer Zani Kardey x2
Akthar Jey Hazara Aj Haye Akthar Jey Hazara Aj
Mola Teray Deewanay
